subject: Close one food and one housing result through evidence, compute usage, and household value

body.text: Use the real household floods as the stress test for the new finance/usage fabric. Select one already accepted/current food result and one already accepted/current housing result. For each, prove a traversable chain: source evidence -> domain result -> originating WorkOccurrence -> physical/provider realization(s) -> attempt(s) -> UsageOccurrence -> EconomicMeasure/CostAllocation where known -> semantic shell query -> evidence. Separately preserve the domain value projection (food acquisition savings/meal value or housing effective-cost/concession value) with its own assumptions and confidence. Do NOT call domain savings 'AI ROI' unless compute price and allocation are evidenced; unknown compute price remains unknown. Produce resource-intensity measures even when dollars are unknown. Then test the reverse traversal from the domain result back to the exact usage/evidence refs. This makes real company work, not a finance demo, the shared communication object.
